Talco, do you perchance remember[XENO:n ]
the day that we two first met?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I was wondering what you'd come out with...[XENO:n ]
You've finally decided to settle some past grudges, have you?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Not at all... I just found it quite moving.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Though we crossed blades, contended for our very lives,[XENO:n ]
here we are standing shoulder-to-shoulder, gazing out at[XENO:n ]
our shared ancestral home...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Hah... Quite. Getting over all that was...
a minor miracle.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

If someone told me a year ago that we'd be doing this,[XENO:n ]
I'd have carved out their spleen for suggesting it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Hah...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
...Talco. About what I said to you before...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
...Yes?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Are your doubts, allayed?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Perhaps...not all of them. However, my answer to[XENO:n ]
the question you posed is more or less ready.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
...Tell me, then.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Melia... You are the last High Entia[XENO:n ]
of imperial blood.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Well, yes, that is true.[XENO:n ]
Although, are you not also...?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Quiet. You must continue the line...[XENO:n ]
You, and none other.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

You can see it in the eyes of the people here, clear as day.[XENO:n ]
They all know, Melia...that you carry within you the light of[XENO:n ]
hope.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

You are the light, Melia. You must lead us...[XENO:n ]
Gather our people under your banner.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I don't think...I ought to be there for that.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Why, Talco? What leads you[XENO:n ]
to say such a thing?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

The fact is, I was an Inquisitor of the Giant God Order,[XENO:n ]
my very existence proscribed by law.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

You know what role the Order played in the imperial[XENO:n ]
family's history. I hardly need to remind you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Talco...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Understand! I regret none of the deeds[XENO:n ]
I did for Yumea-sama.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

But even so... All that I have done in that life...[XENO:n ]
lingers on inside me, a burden I can't escape.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

All I'd do...is cast a deep shadow...[XENO:n ]
on your radiance.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

As the imperial line rises to greet a new age,[XENO:n ]
I would contribute nothing. I'd be a hindrance.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
How can you...hate your own self that much...?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

If *that* is the answer you wish to give me, then it[XENO:n ]
would be wrong for me to speak out against it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
But I will say this, Talco...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Imperial blood yet runs in your veins too.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

As does the mixed blood of a Homs.[XENO:n ]
We are no different. How could we be?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
...At this point, it doesn't mean a damned thing.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
You're wrong...![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Stop talking! I told you not to get your hopes up.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Can it really be your intention to keep blaming yourself?![XENO:n ]
Why?! Why won't you turn your eyes to the future?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Is this what your mother would have wanted?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

How dare you?! You didn't know Yumea.[XENO:n ]
You didn't know my mother![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
...![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Mo-mo! That's enough, both of you-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Nene?! Wh-what are you doing here?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

That doesn't matter-mo! I[XENO:n ]
was only secretly watching a little-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Tarco-san, Melia-san,[XENO:n ]
siblings shouldn't fight-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Whuh...?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

You should apologize quickly-mo.[XENO:n ]
Otherwise Mum will punish you with her fists-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Qu-quit this clowning! We are not-[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

By the way, Nene is the older sister, so even when she[XENO:n ]
fights with Kino, she can apologize right away-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I-it's not because Mum is scary-mo! It's[XENO:n ]
what you call acting like an adult-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Ugh... thinking about it makes my old wounds ache-mo.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

A-anyway, fighting is bad-mo![XENO:n ]
Now apologize honestly-mo![XENO:n ]
Say it: 'I'm sorry.'[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
What is this thing going on about...?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
...Mother, huh?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

If your mother... If Yumea were here now, looking[XENO:n ]
at us like this, I wonder what she would say...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Hey, don't tell me you're taking it seriously?[XENO:n ]
It's spouting nonsense![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Not 'this'-mo! It's[XENO:n ]
Nene-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

...What point is there in talking about it now?[XENO:n ]
There's no way for us to know.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Yumea-sama is dead and gone...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

...My apologies, Talco. I know you put great[XENO:n ]
faith in her... So, I just thought...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

But it's as you say. I'll admit... I never understood[XENO:n ]
your mother's mind, even at the very end.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

...Yumea-sama's devotion to the Giant God Order[XENO:n ]
was how she honoured the imperial line.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

And also...how she channelled her woe[XENO:n ]
over our ultimate fate.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Her spirit contained no falsehood.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
...I see.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Due to the loftiness of her faith, Yumea-sama could be...[XENO:n ]
very severe, towards both me and herself.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I'm sure, if she could see me now...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

...Attending at Yumea-sama's side, serving her[XENO:n ]
unto exhaustion, was my whole life.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Yumea-sama's desires were mine as well. What's more,[XENO:n ]
the blood that flows in me is in essence...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
...Talco?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Yumea-sama's blood, and her will... Are they[XENO:n ]
really doomed to just cease to be...?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Would Yumea really... Would Mother simply allow this...?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Ah... Hahahaha...![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
H-hey, whatever has got into you?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Melia... If Yumea-sama were here, if she saw me...[XENO:n ]
Saw *us* two, here's how she'd rebuke us:[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

'If you wish a future for the High Entia,
you must do whatever is in your power!'[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Huh...?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Changing one's way of life means negating your past self.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I tried to change myself... And the path[XENO:n ]
I walked until then, I disavowed.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

The precious path I had walked[XENO:n ]
as Yumea-sama's loyal retainer...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Let me be me, then. The Empress'...[XENO:n ]
*Your* shadow, and I'll do what's in my power.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

So then, you will not change your ways, but[XENO:n ]
still walk alongside me... Is that correct?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Yumea - Mother - kept me by her side[XENO:n ]
for that purpose. She already showed me[XENO:n ]
the road that I should take.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I think I'd like to repay her...by putting her will into action.[XENO:n ]
For her...and for the future of the High Entia.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I see... So that's the answer you have chosen?[XENO:n ]
...I'm glad that is your decision, Talco.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Hmph... You may be a fitting vessel to inherit the throne,[XENO:n ]
but as a politician, you'll be much too soft for your own good.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

If you got blinded by pretty ideals and came to ruin,[XENO:n ]
I could never face my mother...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
No, I'd never be so...![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Let's face it. You'll need someone to rein[XENO:n ]
you in when you get too blinkered.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Frankly, I find the suggestion somewhat offensive...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

...All right, but in that case, I must[XENO:n ]
make a pronouncement, too.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I, Melia Antiqua, Empress of the High Entia,[XENO:n ]
by mine name do solemnly decree.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Be thou guardian, for our subjects and the[XENO:n ]
race entire. Act the mistress of unseen shadows,[XENO:n ]
and pledge thy very life to this throne.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Swear your might...to my bidding, Talco.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
...I accept. I will honour this commission, Your Majesty.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Heh.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Hmph...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Tarco-san, good job-mo! You apologized properly-mo![XENO:n ]
That's an older sister for you-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Wh-who are you calling an older sister?! And I'll have[XENO:n ]
you know, I've nothing to apologise for![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Mo? But Tarco-san, you did dogeza[XENO:n ]
to Melia-san earlier-mo?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
You little... Are you actively trying to insult me?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Mo-mo! That was definitely dogeza-mo![XENO:n ]
Same as Dad did to Mum-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
...Whatever. I'm too old for this...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
The future...is within our grasp, Aneue.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
